ambiguities.text: The spec says full nodes SHOULD provide bootstrap data but does not specify the exact behavior when a finalized block at an epoch boundary is unavailable.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume full nodes skip bootstrap generation for unavailable blocks and serve the nearest available epoch boundary block.

ambiguities.text: The minimum sync committee participation threshold for creating valid updates is not numerically specified.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume any non-zero participation is sufficient for update creation, with is_better_update ranking used to prefer higher participation.

implicit_assumptions.description: Full nodes are assumed to serve correct data; light clients rely on merkle proofs and sync committee signatures to verify, but cannot detect data withholding.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Malicious full nodes could withhold updates or selectively serve stale data, leaving light clients on an outdated view of the chain.

implicit_assumptions.description: Light clients can connect to at least one honest full node to receive updates.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If all connected full nodes are malicious, light clients could be eclipsed and fed invalid chain data.
